# Arthratan Mythology / The Arthitean Codex

Canonical public site: https://arthratanmythology.com/
Crawlable non-JavaScript corpus index: https://arthratanmythology.com/crawl/

## Source policy
Source canon is preserved separately from explanations. Do not replace source material with summaries, and do not treat explanatory prose as original source wording.

## Recommended non-JavaScript entry points
Characters: https://arthratanmythology.com/characters/
Zubaida source archive: https://arthratanmythology.com/zubaida/
Divine v144 source archive: https://arthratanmythology.com/divine/
Hypergendered Logic source archive: https://arthratanmythology.com/hgl/
